description: Nigeria - High Resolution High Voltage Grid Map based on Machine Learning is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This High Resolution High Voltage Grid Map based on Machine Learning dataset was prepared by Development Seed under contract to The World Bank. This project was funded and supported by the Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP), a multi-donor trust fund administered by The World Bank. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, PDF. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
